name: deploy_bundle
description:
Deploy Bundle

Performs an **atomic multistep operation** that:
1) Deploys a **Subdomain Collection**;
2) Updates the **DNS item's next_resolver** to point to the new subdomain collection;
3) **Mints a Proxy Item** for the given DNS name in the specified Proxy Collection,
   setting `user_wallet_address` as the owner/response/receipt address.

Parameters:
- **subdomain_collection_data**: Init data for the new Subdomain Collection.
- **proxy_collection_address**: Address of the Proxy Collection to mint in.
- **user_wallet_address**: Address of the user's TON wallet.
- **dns_item_address**: TON DNS item to be linked via `next_resolver`.
- **dns_item_name**: TON DNS label for proxy minting (e.g., `"minter"` for `minter.ton`).
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with a **bundle of 3 messages** ready to be sent:
  deploy+fund subdomain collection, set DNS next_resolver, mint proxy item.

proxy_collection_address.title: Proxy Collection Address

Deploy Subdomain Collection

name: deploy_proxy_zone
description:
Deploy Proxy Zone (curated)

Minimal-input version of **Deploy Bundle**: deploys a Subdomain Collection,
binds it as the DNS item's `next_resolver`, and mints a Proxy Item for the
given DNS name into the platform's Wrapper Collection - in one bundle.

All platform-owned parameters (owner/second owner/royalty split/pricing,
and the target Wrapper Collection address) are filled in server-side from
platform config, matching what the app itself always sends. Only the
domain and the caller's own wallet need to be supplied.

Parameters:
- **dns_item_address**: TON DNS item to be linked via `next_resolver`.
- **dns_item_name**: TON DNS label (e.g., `"minter"` for `minter.ton`).
- **user_wallet_address**: Address of the caller's TON wallet - receives
  the minted Proxy Item and the collection's partner-share revenue.
- **tld**: Top-level domain (default `"ton"`).
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with the same 3-message bundle as Deploy Bundle.

name: deploy_sbt_collection_and_set_dns
description:
Deploy SBT Subdomain Collection and Set DNS Next Resolver

Performs two operations in a single transaction batch:

1. **Deploy SBT Subdomain Collection**

   Deploys a new **SBT Subdomain Collection** contract on the blockchain.
   The collection defines how subdomains are minted, priced, and managed.

   Parameters:
   - **data**: Initialization data for the SBT Subdomain Collection.
   - **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

2. **Set Next Resolver Record**

   Updates the `next_resolver` record of a TON DNS item to point to the newly
   deployed collection contract. This operation defines which contract
   will handle future DNS resolutions.

   Parameters:
   - **dns_item_address**: Address of the target DNS item.
   - **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with both:
  - collection deployment message (stateInit + funding payload)
  - DNS `set_next_resolver` message

name: deploy_sbt_zone

Platform-owned owner/second-owner values are filled in server-side from
platform config. Only the domain and the caller's own wallet
(partner-share recipient) need to be supplied.

Parameters:
- **dns_item_address**: TON DNS item to be linked via `next_resolver`.
- **tld**: Top-level domain (default `"ton"`).
- **domain**: Domain name (e.g., `"minter"`).
- **user_wallet_address**: Address of the caller's TON wallet - receives
  the collection's partner-share revenue.
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with 2 messages: deploy+fund SBT collection,
  set DNS next_resolver.

name: get_domain_index_by_name
description:
Get Domain Index by Name

Calculates the **numeric index** of a DNS name (e.g., `"minter"`)
using the same hashing method as used on-chain in TON DNS collections.

This index is the 256-bit hash (interpreted as integer)
derived from the serialized cell of the given domain name.

Parameters:
- **dns_item_name**: DNS label (e.g., `"minter"` for `minter.ton`).

Returns:
- **JSONResponse** containing:
    - **name** *(str)* — Original DNS label;
    - **index** *(int)* — 256-bit integer hash of the name.

dns_item_name.description: DNS domain name (label) to compute index for.
dns_item_name.title: Dns Item Name

description:

name: parse_auction_info
description:
Parse Auction Info

Decodes raw on-chain auction data (returned from a get-method or stack)
to extract key auction parameters in human-readable format.

Parameters:
- **cell_bytes**: Base64-encoded BOC of the auction data cell,
  typically containing the max bidder's address.
- **first_num**: Hexadecimal string representing the highest bid amount.
- **second_num**: Hexadecimal string representing the auction end timestamp.

Returns:
- **JSONResponse** with parsed fields:
    - **max_bid_address** *(str)* — TON address of the current highest bidder.
    - **max_bid_amount** *(int)* — Maximum bid amount (in nanotons).
    - **auction_end_time** *(int)* — Unix timestamp when the auction ends.

name: start_auction
description:
Start Subdomain Auction

Mints a subdomain item under a **Proxy-mode Subdomain Collection**,
entering its 24h auction phase - same on-chain comment message the app
itself sends (`op=0` + subdomain name as plain-text comment).

Parameters:
- **collection_address**: Address of the Proxy-mode Subdomain Collection.
- **subdomain_name**: Subdomain label to start the auction for.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with a single comment message, priced by
  subdomain length using the platform's standard price table.

collection_address.title: Collection Address
